capabilities: Shorten Tasks backlinks to the note basename
Choose among four display modes (filename, heading, both, custom)
Replace all backlink text with a fixed custom string
disambiguation: Only shortens backlinks rendered by the Tasks plugin; it does not affect Obsidian's own Backlinks view or other links.
extras: Relies on Tasks' internal backlink markup (.tasks-backlink a.internal-link), so a future Tasks update could break it; verified working against Tasks 8.2.2. Filenames containing ' > ' can be shortened incorrectly.
intentEvidence: This plugin only shortens backlinks that Tasks itself renders (e.g. in a tasks query block)
motivation: The author built it to scratch a personal itch with Claude Code, doing exactly one small thing, and released it in case others wanted the same fix.
problem: The Tasks plugin shows long backlinks under each task with full file path, heading, and .md extension, which clutters task query results.

relations.evidence: The Tasks plugin, installed and enabled.

summary: Display tweak that shortens the backlinks the Tasks plugin renders under each task, from full path and heading to a compact format.
